data.body_html:
Pride Marbella 2030 is the Costa del Sol's biggest LGBTQ+ celebration, and there's no better way to experience it than from the deck of a private yacht. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet of 16 boats—from the compact Dubhe (5 pax) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax)—offers all-inclusive luxury with a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Whether you want a 2-hour sunset cruise or an 8-hour party marathon, we have the vessel and the route to make your Pride unforgettable.

Why Choose a Yacht for Pride Marbella 2030?

Marbella Pride attracts over 50,000 revellers to the Golden Mile, Puerto Banús, and Marbella Marina. A private yacht gives you VIP access to the coastline, away from crowded beaches and queues. You can anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim, enjoy unlimited cava and beer, and return to the marina for the main parade. All our charters include a skipper who knows the best spots for Pride parties.

Our Top Boats for Pride Marbella 2030

For groups of 10–12, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is the ultimate party machine. It includes a free jet ski, a spacious flybridge, and a sun deck perfect for dancing. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers panoramic views and a large saloon. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) start at €749 for 2 hours—ideal for an intimate celebration.

Pricing for Pride Marbella 2030 Charters

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No hidden fees.

What's Included in Your Pride Charter

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) included

Pride Marbella 2030 Yacht Route

Depart from Puerto Banús, cruise past the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina, then anchor at Cala del Faro or Cabopino for swimming. Optional stops include Estepona or Sotogrande for lunch. The skipper tailors the route to your group's vibe—party music or chill sunset. Return to Puerto Banús in time for the evening parade.

How to Book Your Pride Marbella Yacht Charter

Reserve online or via WhatsApp. A 50% deposit secures your date; full payment due 14 days before departure. Pride week sells out by March 2030, so book early. For groups of 10+, we recommend the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94. For smaller parties, the Tier A boats offer great value. Browse all our Marbella yacht charters for more options.
